'''Devoted Sculptor''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in {{2|Glory}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Devoted Sculptor}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Forbidden Incantation
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains 9 {{BD2|Ritual}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Ritual
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Savage
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (12;{{Asc2|9|15}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Always opens with {{Int2|Devoted Sculptor|Forbidden Incantation}}, then uses {{Int2|Devoted Sculptor|Savage}} every turn afterward.

=== Dialogue ===
When using {{Int2|Devoted Sculptor|Forbidden Incantation}}.
<blockquote><i>
{{TS||shake|CAAAAW!!}}
</i></blockquote>

== Useful Cards ==

* Due to the '''Devoted Sculptor''''s fast damage scaling every turn, it becomes increasingly difficult to consistently block him as the battle goes on. This makes frontloaded damage cards like {{C2|Assassinate}} or {{C2|Dramatic Entrance}} very useful, as they can help finish him off quickly before his {{BD2|Strength}} gets out of hand.
